# Traffic Drop in Sahel due to Transport Maintenance

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-SAH-01-B`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by matching maintenance window MW-0007, link loss alarm ALM-000454, and resulting site down alarms. External events were NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-21 01:15 to 2026-09-21 04:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-21 01:19
- **Affected:** S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-012, LNK-SAH-01-B

## Summary

Routine transport network works performed on shared fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B resulting in a link loss and subsequent site outages on dependent sites S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, and S-SAH-012.

Complete traffic, active users, and availability drop across three sites in Sahel (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-012) lasting for approximately 3.5 hours, starting around 01:15-01:23 and clearing around 04:43-04:45.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-21 01:15: Traffic, active users and availability drop begins on 3 sites in SAH (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-012) [T1, ALR-0031]
- 2026-09-21 01:19: Maintenance window MW-0007 starts on fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B for routine transport network works [T4, MW-0007]
- 2026-09-21 01:22: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on LNK-SAH-01-B [T6, ALM-000454]
- 2026-09-21 01:23: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SAH-012, S-SAH-002, and S-SAH-001 [T2, ALM-000455, ALM-000456, ALM-000457]
- 2026-09-21 04:43: LINK_LOS alarm on LNK-SAH-01-B and SITE_DOWN alarms on S-SAH-002 and S-SAH-001 cleared [T2, T6, ALM-000454, ALM-000456, ALM-000457]
- 2026-09-21 04:44: SITE_DOWN alarm on S-SAH-012 cleared [T2, ALM-000455]
- 2026-09-21 04:45: Detector alert ALR-0031 ended [T1, ALR-0031]
- 2026-09-21 04:52: Maintenance window MW-0007 completed [T4, MW-0007]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users and availability dropped on 3 sites in SAH (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-012) between 2026-09-21 01:15 and 2026-09-21 04:45. [T1, ALR-0031]
- Routine transport network works maintenance window (MW-0007) took place on LNK-SAH-01-B from 2026-09-21 01:19 to 2026-09-21 04:52. [T4, MW-0007]
- Critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on LNK-SAH-01-B starting at 2026-09-21 01:22 and cleared at 2026-09-21 04:43. [T6, ALM-000454]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms occurred on S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, and S-SAH-012 starting at 2026-09-21 01:23 and cleared around 2026-09-21 04:43-04:44. [T2, ALM-000455, ALM-000456, ALM-000457]
- No unplanned configuration changes were made on the affected sites or their parents during the window. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SAH-01-B: confirmed. Maintenance window MW-0007 perfectly overlaps the timeframe of the traffic drop and causes the LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN alarms on the dependent sites. [T4, T6, MW-0007, ALM-000454]

## Ruled out

- T5: No unplanned configuration changes were detected on the affected sites or their ancestor nodes during the specified window.

## Recommended actions

- Ensure transport maintenance notifications are clearly mapped to expected service interruptions to manage automated alerts properly.
- Verify redundant paths if available to mitigate complete site isolation during routine transport maintenance.
